entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I need to return the VeloBand I just bought. It's defective.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
The pulse reading is complete garbage. Look, I don't have time to play twenty questions. I just want a refund.
I understand your frustration. Often with new devices, a quick troubleshooting step can resolve sensor inaccuracies. I could walk you through a reset, or transfer you to our technical team...
No. I am not doing that. I just want my money back. I'm busy and I don't have time for a back-and-forth. Can you process the return or not?
Okay, I understand. One moment while I pull up your account and review the policy for your order.
Alright, I have your order details here. I can see you received the item 8 days ago. You are well within our 90-day return window, so I can definitely process that for you.
Good. So you're sending a return label?
Yes, absolutely. I've just approved the return for a full refund. The pre-paid shipping label is on its way to the email address we have on file. You should receive it in the next few minutes.
You're welcome. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
